units.text: INT. APPELLATE COURTROOM - DAY
Dark wood, high bench, a brass seal.
A hush.
ATTORNEY RUTH ELLINGSWORTH, 50s, stands at the lectern in a navy suit.
Her papers are squared.
Her hands are not.
JUSTICE AMADOU DIALLO-FERNANDEZ, 60s, looks down from the bench over half-moon glasses.
He has been listening for an hour.
Ms. Ellingsworth, your time is nearly up.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: I understand, Your Honor. If I may conclude.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: You may.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: The trial court erred in excluding the recording. Without it, the jury never heard my client's own words.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Words he spoke to a priest.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: To a man who was not, in fact, a priest.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: So you say.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: So the record says. Exhibit nine.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: He flips pages.
She waits.
The door at the back opens with a creak.
A BAILIFF, 30s, hurries down the aisle and hands the Justice a folded note.
He reads.
His face changes.
Ms. Ellingsworth, I'm informed that the State has just withdrawn its opposition.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: Withdrawn?
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Entirely. Your client's conviction is to be vacated.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: Ruth looks at the back of the room.
Her opponent's chair is empty.
Her phone buzzes against the lectern.
She turns it over.
A name on the screen.
Your Honor, may I take this?
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Please.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: She raises the phone to her ear.
Ma'am, front desk. The real priest just walked in. He confirmed it.
units.name: BAILIFF

units.text: Ruth lowers the phone and lets her breath out slowly.
The Justice watches her.
She nods once.
Thank you, Your Honor.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Don't thank me yet. The paperwork alone will take until Friday.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: Friday is fine.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: I thought it might be.
units.name: JUSTICE DIALLO-FERNANDEZ

units.text: She gathers her papers.
He returns to his notes without another glance.
The Bailiff holds the door.
Ruth walks out with a straight back and unsteady knees.
